assessment.selection_metric: mean of the five development-fold Spearman correlations
assessment.production_promotion: None in this screening step; reduced formulas and their full-development coefficient centers are saved for review.
assessment.unavailable_effects: Do not include N/S/pH/method/extra-ion effects as independently fitted MPEA terms; those fields are unrecorded.
assessment.sparse_temperature: Four development observations, with only one observed context value in fold 2; omitted from this first screen.
assessment.deduplication: Original rules that differ only in omitted terms collapse to the same reduced candidate; they are not counted as independent successes.
assessment.recommendation: Keep the simple Cr-Mo-W/chloride rule as a reference. Investigate material effects outside Cr/Mo/W before promoting an MPEA prior; fitting these inherited terms alone gives weak and unstable development rankings.
